items.title_en: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
items.abstract_en: Long-term memory lets LLM agents personalize, stay consistent, and reuse what worked before. Parametric memories need training, consolidation can lose details for good, and keeping every record leaves a growing store to search. We present MIRIX-2.0, a multi-agent memory system designed to be practical, accurate, and efficient at once. It is the most accurate of the compared systems on four of five QA benchmarks. It reaches 91.4% on LoCoMo and 72.6% on LongMemEval-S, where it leads the strongest baseline by 14.3 points, and with AutoDream disabled it gains 31.0 and 22.0 points over HyperMem on single-hop and multi-hop document QA. As procedural memory, it yields the highest mean success among the compared memory methods on ALFWorld and WebShop and reaches 49.2% on MetaClaw-Bench, against 44.0% for MetaClaw's skill library. Six typed memory agents keep complete records as the system of record, and a provenance hypergraph indexes episodic and semantic records with n-ary frames that cite their rows. Retrieval runs under explicit budgets, so the evidence a question inspects does not grow with the history. AutoDream merges duplicate anchors outside the write path without rewriting any record, and it distills task sessions into skills. With AutoDream disabled, MIRIX-2.0 answers faster than HyperMem on all five timed benchmarks. It needs no fine-tuning, runs with closed and open models, and its code is public.

recommendation.reason_zh: 比较智能体如何存储与检索长期记忆，并在记忆中记录信息来源。作者提供框架实现。
recommendation.limitations_zh: 端到端效果依赖数据库、检索配置与被测智能体，仓库本身不能证明可达到论文的评测成绩。

items.title_zh: MIRIX-2.0：多智能体记忆系统
items.abstract_zh: 长期记忆使 LLM 智能体能够个性化、保持一致并复用此前有效的做法。参数化记忆需要训练，整合可能永久丢失细节，而保留每条记录会留下一个不断增长、需要搜索的存储。我们提出 MIRIX-2.0，一个多智能体记忆系统，设计目标是同时做到实用、准确和高效。在五个 QA 基准中的四个上，它是所比较系统中最准确的。它在 LoCoMo 上达到 91.4%，在 LongMemEval-S 上达到 72.6%，在该基准上以 14.3 分领先最强基线；在禁用 AutoDream 时，它在单跳和多跳文档 QA 上分别比 HyperMem 提升 31.0 分和 22.0 分。作为程序性记忆，它在 ALFWorld 和 WebShop 上在所比较的记忆方法中取得最高平均成功率，并在 MetaClaw-Bench 上达到 49.2%，而 MetaClaw 的技能库为 44.0%。六个类型化记忆智能体作为记录系统保存完整记录，一个溯源超图用 n 元帧索引情景记录和语义记录，这些帧引用其所在行。检索在显式预算下运行，因此问题所检查的证据不会随历史增长。AutoDream 在写路径之外合并重复锚点，且不重写任何记录，并将任务会话蒸馏为技能。禁用 AutoDream 时，MIRIX-2.0 在所有五个计时基准上回答速度快于 HyperMem。它无需微调，可与闭源和开源模型一起运行，代码公开。

items.title_en: ZoomGain: Mining Global-to-Zoom Perception Gaps for Fine-Grained Visual Supervision
items.abstract_en: Fine-grained visual perception requires Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to locate and interpret subtle evidence within complex scenes. Constructing supervision for this ability is challenging: questions must have correct, unambiguous answers that depend on actual fine-grained visual details rather than coarse cues or language priors. Verifying these properties makes manual annotation labor-intensive and automatic generation difficult for models that themselves struggle with fine-grained perception. Yet the same models can often recognize such details once the region is zoomed in. We exploit this global-to-zoom perception gap and introduce ZoomGain, a data construction pipeline that constructs questions about the full image from visual information gained only by zooming in. It verifies each answer on the zoomed view with multiple models, ensures that each question remains unambiguous in the full image and cannot be answered from language priors, and specifically generates high-quality distractors for multiple-choice questions. With this pipeline and human-only screening (no manual QA editing), we build ZoomGainBench, a 1,000-question bilingual benchmark on which the best of 28 VLMs achieves only 61.08. Failure analysis reveals that models favor a particular type of distractor when answering multiple-choice questions incorrectly. Beyond evaluation, training on just 9K ZoomGain samples substantially improves the visual perception capabilities of our 4B/9B models, enabling them to outperform several hundred-billion-parameter models across various perception benchmarks. The trained 9B model achieves SoTA performance on several benchmarks, such as 90.25 on HR-Bench 4K. These results establish global-to-zoom perception gaps as a practical basis for scaling fine-grained visual supervision for both evaluation and training. Our code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/ZoomGain.

items.title_zh: ZoomGain：挖掘全局到放大的感知差距以进行细粒度视觉监督
items.abstract_zh: 细粒度视觉感知要求视觉语言模型（VLM）在复杂场景中定位并解释细微证据。为这种能力构建监督很困难：问题必须具有正确、无歧义的答案，且答案取决于实际的细粒度视觉细节，而不是粗粒度线索或语言先验。验证这些性质使人工标注劳动密集，而自动生成对于自身在细粒度感知上有困难的模型而言也很困难。然而，同样的模型一旦将区域放大，往往就能识别这些细节。我们利用这种全局到放大的感知差距，提出 ZoomGain，一个数据构建流程，它仅根据通过放大获得的视觉信息来构建关于完整图像的问题。它用多个模型在放大视图上验证每个答案，确保每个问题在完整图像中仍然无歧义且不能从语言先验回答，并专门为多项选择题生成高质量干扰项。借助该流程和仅人工筛选（不进行人工 QA 编辑），我们构建了 ZoomGainBench，一个包含 1,000 个问题的双语基准，在 28 个 VLM 中最佳者仅达到 61.08。失败分析揭示，模型在错误回答多项选择题时偏好某一类干扰项。除评估外，仅用 9K 个 ZoomGain 样本训练就能显著提升我们 4B/9B 模型的视觉感知能力，使其在各种感知基准上优于若干千亿参数模型。训练后的 9B 模型在多个基准上取得 SoTA 性能，例如在 HR-Bench 4K 上达到 90.25。这些结果确立了全局到放大感知差距作为扩展用于评估和训练的细粒度视觉监督的实用基础。我们的代码见 https://github.com/inclusionAI/ZoomGain。

items.title_en: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
items.abstract_en: Discrete autoregressive models offer a scalable framework for image generation. However, they face a fundamental trade-off: long token sequences preserve representation quality but slow generation, while aggressive spatial compression reduces representation capacity. Based on product quantization, we show that, under a fixed nominal information budget, group size should scale quadratically with the per-axis spatial compression factor. Building on this principle, we propose GSTAR, a spatial--group co-scaling framework that enables \(32\times\) and even effective \(64\times\) compression while preserving strong reconstruction, understanding, and generation performance. Since larger groups introduce intra-group dependencies that must be modeled efficiently, we analyze their impact on inference latency and generation quality and introduce a semi-autoregressive decoder that combines parallel feature computation with lightweight causal modeling. With these designs, our highly compressed models perform competitively with leading models across five representative text-to-image benchmarks (GenEval, DPG-Bench, PRISM, LongText-Bench, and Qwen-Image-Bench). At \(1024\times1024\) resolution, our model delivers a \(20\times\) speedup over prior discrete autoregressive models, generating each image in 2.5 seconds on a single NVIDIA H200. Together, these results show that highly compressed discrete representations can enable high-quality autoregressive generation at low latency.

items.title_zh: G-STAR：面向深度压缩自回归生成的组缩放 token 容量
items.abstract_zh: 离散自回归模型为图像生成提供了可扩展框架。然而，它们面临一个基本权衡：长 token 序列能保持表示质量但会拖慢生成，而激进的空间压缩会降低表示容量。基于乘积量化，我们表明，在固定的名义信息预算下，组大小应随每轴空间压缩因子呈二次方缩放。基于这一原则，我们提出 GSTAR，一个空间—组协同缩放框架，可在保持较强重建、理解和生成性能的同时实现 32× 乃至有效的 64× 压缩。由于更大的组会引入必须在效率上建模的组内依赖，我们分析其对推理延迟和生成质量的影响，并引入一个半自回归解码器，将并行特征计算与轻量因果建模相结合。借助这些设计，我们的高度压缩模型在五个代表性文本到图像基准（GenEval、DPG-Bench、PRISM、LongText-Bench 和 Qwen-Image-Bench）上与领先模型竞争。在 1024×1024 分辨率下，我们的模型相较先前的离散自回归模型实现 20× 加速，在单块 NVIDIA H200 上每 2.5 秒生成一张图像。这些结果共同表明，高度压缩的离散表示能够在低延迟下实现高质量自回归生成。

items.title_en: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
items.title_zh: Open Vision Banana：面向生成式视觉感知的完全开放方案
items.abstract_en: Recent work suggests that pretrained image generators encode real-world understanding beyond image synthesis. Vision Banana exploits this by framing vision tasks as conditional image editing. However, its data, weights, code, and implementation details are not public. We present Open Vision Banana (OVB), a fully open and reproducible recipe for converting pretrained generators into unified multi-task perception systems. Our analyses identify the design choices that matter most for generalization, including color encoding, prompt design, parameter adaptation, and task balancing. These choices interact, so individually helpful choices can hurt when combined with others. Starting from 4B and 9B parameter open-weight base models and using 2.1M-3.8M training pairs from public datasets, OVB surpasses Vision Banana's reported Cityscapes zero-shot performance (73.9 vs. 69.9 mIoU) and rivals state-of-the-art affine-invariant depth estimators. Its non-zero-shot variants come within five points of Vision Banana on referring and reasoning segmentation but remain further behind on instance segmentation. All models largely retain the base model's image-editing abilities. With legend ensembling, we introduce a test-time scaling method for generator-based perception. It segments an image under several class-color legends and fuses the results by majority vote, correcting unstable color-class bindings and improving mIoU by up to 8.7 points on Cityscapes and 15.0 points on COCO-Object without retraining. We release the dataset construction and processing pipeline, the training and evaluation code, as well as the final, intermediate, and ablation checkpoints. Project website: https://openvisionbanana.github.io
items.abstract_zh: 近期工作表明，预训练图像生成器编码了超越图像合成的真实世界理解。Vision Banana 通过将视觉任务表述为条件图像编辑来利用这一点。然而，其数据、权重、代码和实现细节未公开。我们提出 Open Vision Banana（OVB），一个完全开放且可复现的方案，用于将预训练生成器转换为统一的多任务感知系统。我们的分析识别了对泛化最重要的设计选择，包括颜色编码、提示设计、参数自适应和任务平衡。这些选择相互作用，因此单独有益的选择在与其他选择结合时可能有害。从 4B 和 9B 参数的开源权重基础模型出发，并使用来自公开数据集的 210 万–380 万训练对，OVB 超越了 Vision Banana 报告的 Cityscapes 零样本性能（73.9 对 69.9 mIoU），并与最先进的仿射不变深度估计器相当。其非零样本变体在指代分割和推理分割上距 Vision Banana 五个点以内，但在实例分割上仍落后更多。所有模型在很大程度上保留了基础模型的图像编辑能力。通过图例集成，我们引入了一种用于基于生成器的感知的测试时扩展方法。它在若干类别-颜色图例下分割图像，并通过多数投票融合结果，纠正不稳定的颜色-类别绑定，并在无需重新训练的情况下将 Cityscapes 上的 mIoU 提高最多 8.7 个点、COCO-Object 上提高 15.0 个点。我们发布数据集构建与处理流程、训练和评估代码，以及最终、中间和消融检查点。项目网站：https://openvisionbanana.github.io

items.title_en: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
items.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model. Diffusion drafters such as DFlash propose an entire token block in a single forward pass, but mainly focus on text-only tasks, leaving multimodal drafting underexplored. To study this setting, we first introduce a metric of token-level visual dependence based on the KL divergence between next-token distributions with and without visual input. We find that acceptance rates decrease from 46% in the lowest visual-dependence quartile to 22% in the highest, with this disparity persisting after multimodal training. Motivated by this observation, we propose MMFlash, a simple and effective framework that adaptively upweights visually dependent tokens that the drafter predicts poorly. For long video inputs, MMFlash further employs sparse attention to reduce redundant attention computation and improve drafting quality. Across various multimodal benchmarks, MMFlash achieves lossless decoding speedups of up to $3.58\times$, outperforming EAGLE-3 and DFlash by up to 195.4% and 17.1%, respectively.

recommendation.reason_zh: 为视觉语言模型改进推测解码，作者仓库提供实现和基准脚本，可对照生成吞吐量。

items.title_zh: MMFlash：加速视觉语言模型的推测解码
items.abstract_zh: 投机解码通过让轻量草稿模型提出 token，由目标模型并行验证，从而加速生成。DFlash 等扩散草稿模型在单次前向传播中提出整个 token 块，但主要关注纯文本任务，多模态草稿仍未得到充分探索。为研究这一设定，我们首先引入一种基于有/无视觉输入时下一 token 分布之间 KL 散度的 token 级视觉依赖度量。我们发现，接受率从最低视觉依赖四分位的 46% 降至最高四分位的 22%，且这种差距在多模态训练后仍然存在。受此观察启发，我们提出 MMFlash，一个简单有效的框架，自适应地提高草稿模型预测较差的视觉依赖 token 的权重。对于长视频输入，MMFlash 进一步采用稀疏注意力以减少冗余注意力计算并提升草稿质量。在各种多模态基准上，MMFlash 实现最高 3.58× 的无损解码加速，分别比 EAGLE-3 和 DFlash 高出最高 195.4% 和 17.1%。

items.title_en: HARP-Bench: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Around Active Humans
items.abstract_en: Recent robot manipulation benchmarks have enabled systematic evaluation of general-purpose robot policies across diverse objects, scenes, instructions, and embodiments. However, most existing benchmarks still assume that the robot is the only active agent and that task semantics are determined primarily by the instruction and object state. This assumption overlooks a common source of real-world variation: humans actively sharing the workspace. In such settings, humans may reveal an implicit goal, complete part of the task, temporarily change object availability, or constrain safe robot motion while working nearby. We introduce HARP-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating robot manipulation policies in workspaces shared with active humans. HARP-Bench treats human activity as part of the manipulation problem, rather than as background scene variation. It organizes human-present manipulation into four conditions: Cueing, Contribution, Interruption, and Co-presence. These conditions are instantiated through everyday manipulation tasks, including paired human-present variants for controlled comparison with standard manipulation. HARP-Bench also provides a demonstration-generation pipeline for dynamic human-present settings. We evaluate VLA models, imitation-learning methods, and heuristic policies on HARP-Bench. Human-present variations challenge current policies, and higher task success does not consistently improve safety. Quantitative failure analysis identifies manipulation and recovery as the dominant remaining challenges. Training with HARP-Bench demonstrations improves human-present performance in simulation. A real-world study on one task family shows improved performance under human contribution, but not interruption, providing initial evidence of the data's utility and identifying limits of transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/harp.

items.title_zh: HARP-Bench：评测活跃人类周围机器人操作的基准
items.abstract_zh: 近期的机器人操作基准使得能够在多样物体、场景、指令和具身形态上系统评估通用机器人策略。然而，大多数现有基准仍假设机器人是唯一活跃智能体，且任务语义主要由指令和物体状态决定。这一假设忽略了现实世界变化的一个常见来源：人类主动共享工作空间。在此类设定中，人类可能揭示隐含目标、完成部分任务、临时改变物体可用性，或在附近工作时约束机器人的安全运动。我们提出 HARP-Bench，一个用于评估与活跃人类共享工作空间中机器人操作策略的基准。HARP-Bench 将人类活动视为操作问题的一部分，而不是背景场景变化。它将有人类在场的操作组织为四种条件：提示（Cueing）、贡献（Contribution）、中断（Interruption）和共在（Co-presence）。这些条件通过日常操作任务实例化，包括与标准操作进行受控比较的成对人类在场变体。HARP-Bench 还为动态人类在场设定提供演示生成流程。我们在 HARP-Bench 上评估 VLA 模型、模仿学习方法和启发式策略。人类在场变体对当前策略构成挑战，更高的任务成功率并不一定持续提升安全性。定量失败分析指出，操作和恢复是剩余的主要挑战。使用 HARP-Bench 演示进行训练可提升模拟中的人类在场性能。针对一个任务家族的真实世界研究表明，在人类贡献下性能提升，但在中断下没有提升，这提供了该数据有用性的初步证据，并识别了迁移的局限。代码见 https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/harp。

items.title_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation with Teacher Evolution
items.abstract_en: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), which aligns a student model's token-level distribution with that of its self-teacher prompted by privileged context, has emerged as a promising direction to mitigate reward sparsity in sequence-level post-training paradigms. However, OPSD often fails to achieve continuous performance gains during training. In this paper, we find that the model's limited self-teaching capability underlies this phenomenon by generating unreliable guidance on certain samples. To address this problem, we propose Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation (TESD), which enables the self-teacher to generate rollouts and receive environmental feedback based on task correctness and context independence. First, using these rewards as training objectives, we perform teacher-oriented optimization to continuously enhance the model's self-teaching capability during distillation. Second, by estimating teacher guidance reliability from these rewards, we apply adaptive student-oriented optimization to down-weight samples with unreliable guidance. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets and model scales show that TESD consistently outperforms representative token-level and sequence-level methods, highlighting the necessity of improving supervision quality in OPSD.

recommendation.reason_zh: 用任务反馈改进自蒸馏中的教师输出，再按监督可靠性给学生样本加权。适合对照不同后训练方法如何处理错误监督。

items.title_zh: 基于教师进化的同策略自蒸馏
items.abstract_zh: 同策略自蒸馏（On-Policy Self-Distillation, OPSD）通过特权上下文提示的自教师，将学生模型的 token 级分布与其对齐，已成为缓解序列级后训练范式中奖励稀疏性的一个有前景方向。然而，OPSD 在训练过程中往往无法实现持续的性能提升。在本文中，我们发现，模型有限的自教学能力是这一现象的根本原因，因为它会在某些样本上生成不可靠的指导。为解决该问题，我们提出教师进化自蒸馏（Teacher-Evolution Self-Distillation, TESD），使自教师能够生成 rollout，并基于任务正确性和上下文独立性接收环境反馈。首先，利用这些奖励作为训练目标，我们执行面向教师的优化，以在蒸馏过程中持续增强模型的自教学能力。其次，通过从这些奖励估计教师指导的可靠性，我们应用自适应的面向学生优化，对指导不可靠的样本降权。跨多个数据集和模型规模的广泛实验表明，TESD 始终优于代表性的 token 级和序列级方法，突显了提升 OPSD 中监督质量的必要性。

items.title_en: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
items.title_zh: 拆解多模态视觉编码：视觉先验、专用容量与融合位置
items.abstract_en: How multimodal language models should encode visual input remains up for debate. Most models use a pretrained vision encoder, while some recent recipes train the encoder from scratch with the language model or remove it entirely. Vision encoders bundle together three design choices: a visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and pre-fusion placement of that capacity (i.e., before the multimodal backbone). Because published models also differ in data, architecture, and compute, comparing them cannot isolate the effect of each choice. We disentangle these choices via a controlled framework where we pretrain all models from scratch on common data and compare them on visual question answering and language benchmarks at matched lifetime compute. We find that the visual prior is not necessary; an encoder trained jointly from scratch is on par with a pretrained one, without a separate training stage. What matters instead is dedicated vision capacity: an encoder-free model trails on visual understanding even when its backbone is enlarged by the encoder's parameter count. Yet that capacity need not precede multimodal fusion, as vision-only modules added in-fusion to early backbone layers perform comparably to a pre-fusion encoder and can lower time to first token. These results also hold across backbone sizes, when encoder pretraining is treated as free, and when starting from a pretrained language model. Overall, our findings favor dedicated vision capacity trained jointly with the backbone and placed early within it.
items.abstract_zh: 多模态语言模型如何编码视觉输入仍无定论：多数用预训练视觉编码器，也有方案与语言模型联合从零训练甚至完全去掉编码器。编码器实际捆绑了三种设计选择：上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量、以及把该容量置于多模态主干之前。由于公开模型在数据、架构与算力上各异，直接比较无法分离各因素。我们将所有模型在相同数据上从零预训练，并在等量生命周期算力下比较视觉问答与语言基准。结果显示视觉先验并非必需，联合从零训练的编码器与预训练编码器表现相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量——无编码器模型即便扩大主干仍落后。但该容量不必位于融合前：在融合中向早期层加入纯视觉模块效果相当，还能降低首字延迟。这些结论支持与主干联合训练、置于主干早期的专用视觉容量。
items.highlight_zh: 视觉先验非必需，专用视觉容量才是关键
items.digest_zh:
【要解决的问题】能看图说话的多模态大模型，通常先用一个专门的视觉编码器把图片变成向量，再交给语言模型。这个编码器到底必要吗？它其实捆绑了三样东西：(1) 上游预训练带来的“视觉先验”；(2) 专门留给视觉的参数量；(3) 把视觉放在多模态融合之前的位置。以往公开模型在数据、结构、算力上都不一样，因此无法判断到底是哪一项在起作用。

【方法】作者把所有模型都放到同一份数据上从零开始训练，并让它们在整个训练生命周期内消耗相同的总算力，然后比较它们在视觉问答和纯语言任务上的表现，把三个因素逐一拆开来检验。

【结果】1) 视觉先验不是必需的：与语言模型一起从零训练的编码器，和预训练编码器打平，还省掉一个独立的训练阶段；2) 真正重要的是“专用视觉容量”——必须给视觉留出参数，把主干按编码器的参数量加大也补不回来；3) 容量不必放在融合之前：在融合过程中往主干靠前的层里插入视觉模块，效果差不多，还能更快吐出第一个 token。

【为何重要】这给多模态模型设计提供了清晰指引：不必执着于预训练视觉编码器，而应保留独立的视觉容量、与主干联合训练并放在早期层，同时也为降低推理延迟提供了可行方案。结论在多种主干规模下、以及把编码器预训练视作“免费”或从预训练语言模型出发时都成立。

items.title_en: Verifier Choice is a Benchmark Design Variable: Auditing Structural Counting Evaluation in Text-to-Image Models
items.abstract_en: Automatic evaluation is now central to text-to-image benchmarking, but the verifier that converts generated images into scores is often treated as an implementation detail. We argue that this is unsafe: an automatic benchmark score is a property of the image generator, prompt distribution, verifier, verifier-use protocol, and scoring rule, not of the generator alone. We study this issue in structural counting, a controlled setting where human-visible counts can be audited. We construct a verifier-centric audit suite over seven counting objects: cell phones, chairs, and traffic lights for object counting, and clover leaflets, dresser drawer fronts, power-strip sockets, and turbine blades for substructure counting. Across 6,240 generated images from Qwen-Image-2512 and FLUX.2-dev, we compare open MLLM verifiers under count-only, reject-aware, zero-shot and few-shot protocols, plus TIFA-like target queries, a detector baseline, and frontier closed-model checks on two hard objects. On a balanced 2,280-image evaluation split, aggregate score matching can coexist with image-level disagreement, and verifier-use protocols and generator distributions change the measured reliability. Every verifier-protocol configuration also shrinks the human score difference between the two generators, by 7.5-25.0 pp, and with a third generator, Z-Image, all four tested protocols reverse the human ordering of Z-Image and FLUX.2-dev on our fixed prompt suite. GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7 checks do not remove the failure modes: GPT-5.5 still has only 59.92% clover valid-count fidelity, while Claude Opus 4.7 has lower same-slice agreement ($κ=0.432$). We propose reporting automatic benchmark scores with a factorized verifier reliability profile: aggregate score gap, image-level agreement, generator-comparison distortion, valid-image count fidelity, rejection behavior, output compliance, and directional bias.

items.title_zh: 验证器选择是基准设计变量：审计文本到图像模型中的结构计数评估
items.abstract_zh: 自动评估如今已成为文本到图像基准测试的核心，但将生成图像转换为分数的验证器往往被视为实现细节。我们认为这不安全：自动基准分数是图像生成器、提示分布、验证器、验证器使用协议和评分规则的属性，而不仅是生成器本身的属性。我们在结构计数这一可控设置中研究该问题，其中人类可见的计数可以被审计。我们构建了一个以验证器为中心的审计套件，覆盖七个计数对象：用于目标计数的手机、椅子和交通灯，以及用于子结构计数的三叶草小叶、梳妆台抽屉面板、电源插排插座和涡轮叶片。在来自 Qwen-Image-2512 和 FLUX.2-dev 的 6,240 张生成图像上，我们比较了开放 MLLM 验证器在仅计数、拒绝感知、零样本和少样本协议下的表现，并加入类似 TIFA 的目标查询、一个检测器基线，以及对两个困难对象的前沿闭源模型检查。在一个平衡的 2,280 张图像评估划分上，聚合分数匹配可以与图像级不一致并存，且验证器使用协议和生成器分布会改变所测得的可靠性。每一种验证器-协议配置还都会缩小两个生成器之间的人类分数差，缩小幅度为 7.5–25.0 个百分点；并且加入第三个生成器 Z-Image 后，在我们固定的提示套件上，所有四种测试协议都逆转了 Z-Image 与 FLUX.2-dev 的人类排序。GPT-5.5 和 Claude Opus 4.7 的检查并未消除这些失效模式：GPT-5.5 在三叶草有效计数保真度上仍仅为 59.92%，而 Claude Opus 4.7 的同切片一致性更低（κ=0.432）。我们提出用分解式验证器可靠性画像来报告自动基准分数：聚合分数差、图像级一致性、生成器比较失真、有效图像计数保真度、拒绝行为、输出合规性和方向性偏差。

items.title_en: SplatAnything: Gaussian Spacing Normalization for Feed-forward 3DGS across Arbitrary Scenes
items.title_zh: SplatAnything：面向多样场景的高斯间距归一化前馈三维重建
items.abstract_en: We identify a key limitation of existing feed-forward 3DGS methods: Gaussian attributes are typically predicted in a radial-distance-normalized space that canonicalizes a global radial statistic of the reconstructed geometry, while the spacing between neighboring Gaussian centers can still vary substantially across scene scales and camera configurations. This mismatch induces systematic shifts in Gaussian-scale targets, leading to ambiguous supervision. To address this, we propose SplatAnything with Gaussian Spacing Normalization (GSNorm), which canonicalizes a robust scene-level statistic of Gaussian spacing to provide a more consistent spatial reference for Gaussian prediction. To rigorously assess our method, we further establish a systematic benchmark spanning diverse datasets, input sparsity levels, and challenging extrapolated viewpoints. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SplatAnything achieves state-of-the-art performance, with particularly strong gains under substantial variations in scene scale and viewpoint.
items.abstract_zh: 我们指出已有前馈3DGS方法的一个关键局限：高斯属性通常在径向距离归一化空间中预测，该空间将重建几何的一个全局径向统计量规范化，而相邻高斯中心之间的间距在不同场景尺度和相机配置下仍可能显著变化。这种不匹配会导致高斯尺度目标出现系统性偏移，从而产生模糊的监督。为解决该问题，我们提出SplatAnything，并引入高斯间距归一化（GSNorm），它将高斯间距的一个稳健场景级统计量规范化，从而为高斯预测提供更一致的空间参考。为严格评估我们的方法，我们进一步建立了一个系统基准，涵盖多样数据集、输入稀疏度水平以及具有挑战性的外推视角。大量实验表明，SplatAnything达到最先进性能，在场景尺度和视角发生显著变化时增益尤为明显。

items.title_en: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
items.abstract_en: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.

items.title_zh: TraceKV：面向推理视觉-语言模型的策略保持低秩 KV 缓存压缩
items.abstract_zh: 推理视觉-语言模型（VLM）由于大规模多模态上下文和不断增长的推理轨迹，对 KV 缓存提出了很高需求。低秩 KV 压缩已成为一种有前景的范式，它存储 KV 状态的低维潜变量，并可与量化结合。然而，现有低秩方法在压缩推理 KV 状态时，往往会导致相对于稠密模型逐渐增大的预测策略漂移，进而造成推理失败。我们识别出这种退化的两个关键原因：静态上下文与同策略（on-policy）推理状态之间的校准状态不匹配，以及不同 KV 状态之间误差敏感度不均衡。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 TraceKV，一种免训练的低秩 KV 压缩框架，在单一策略保持原则下统一了同策略校准、敏感度感知 SVD 和全局秩分配，显著降低推理过程中的策略-KL 散度。跨多个 VLM 和视觉推理基准的实验表明其具有更优的精度—内存权衡，与量化结合时在 5.64× KV 缓存压缩下实现近乎无损的推理精度。优化后的低秩注意力核进一步带来最高 1.83× 的端到端解码加速。代码将发布于 https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV。

items.title_en: Learning Low-Latency Action Verification for Frozen Vision-Language-Action Models
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have made significant progress in general-purpose robotic manipulation. However, sampled action sequences can be ineffective, while evaluating alternatives with computationally expensive verifiers adds latency at each policy query. In this work, we propose HDH, a lightweight framework that uses hindsight from a frozen VLA's own deployments to improve action verification. The framework has three stages. First, we deploy the policy and collect its autonomous rollouts. We then train a compact action verifier to assign each action chunk a predicted task-success score. Finally, the frozen VLA generates action candidates, and the verifier selects the candidate with the highest score for execution. Across four LIBERO-10 tasks, HDH achieves an average success rate of 82.3\% and on three real-world manipulation tasks, HDH improves average success over the baseline policy by 22.6\%.

items.title_zh: 为冻结的视觉-语言-动作模型学习低延迟动作验证
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作方面取得了显著进展。然而，采样的动作序列可能无效，而使用计算昂贵的验证器评估替代方案会在每次策略查询时增加延迟。在这项工作中，我们提出 HDH，一个轻量级框架，利用冻结 VLA 自身部署中的后见经验来改进动作验证。该框架分为三个阶段。首先，我们部署策略并收集其自主 rollout。然后，我们训练一个紧凑的动作验证器，为每个动作块分配预测的任务成功分数。最后，冻结的 VLA 生成动作候选，验证器选择分数最高的候选执行。在四个 LIBERO-10 任务上，HDH 达到 82.3% 的平均成功率；在三个真实世界操作任务上，HDH 将平均成功率较基线策略提高 22.6%。

items.title_en: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
items.abstract_en: Tree boosting is a highly effective and widely used machine learning method. In this paper, we describe a scalable end-to-end tree boosting system called XGBoost, which is used widely by data scientists to achieve state-of-the-art results on many machine learning challenges. We propose a novel sparsity-aware algorithm for sparse data and weighted quantile sketch for approximate tree learning. More importantly, we provide insights on cache access patterns, data compression and sharding to build a scalable tree boosting system. By combining these insights, XGBoost scales beyond billions of examples using far fewer resources than existing systems.

items.title_zh: XGBoost：一个可扩展的树提升系统
items.abstract_zh: 树提升是一种非常有效且广泛使用的机器学习方法。在本文中，我们描述了一个名为 XGBoost 的可扩展端到端树提升系统，数据科学家广泛使用它在许多机器学习挑战上取得最先进的结果。我们提出了一种针对稀疏数据的新型稀疏感知算法，以及用于近似树学习的加权分位数草图。更重要的是，我们提供了关于缓存访问模式、数据压缩和分片的见解，以构建可扩展的树提升系统。通过结合这些见解，XGBoost 使用比现有系统少得多的资源，可扩展到数十亿个样本以上。

items.title_en: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
items.title_zh: 第8届LSVOS挑战赛报告：移动统一多模态理解
items.abstract_en: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026. MUMU asks for a single unified model that jointly performs multi-concept image tagging over quality, scene, and event vocabularies, open-vocabulary object detection, and concise image captioning, within a budget of 0.5B parameters and 8 GB of peak inference memory. Submissions are ranked by a weighted task score scaled by an efficiency factor. We describe the tasks, rules, and evaluation protocol, report the final results, and review the methods of the top three teams. All three leading solutions build on the compact Florence-2-base model, but extend it in different ways: lightweight tagging heads with cross-task inference refinement, a shared low-rank adapter trained on coverage-aware multi-source data with task-dependent decoding, and a training-free pipeline that maps captions to tags and applies detection test-time augmentation. The results show that a compact prompt-based vision-language model can serve all three outputs when supervision, decoding, and cross-task cues are designed for each task, while open-vocabulary detection on novel categories remains the main bottleneck.
items.abstract_zh: 本报告总结了与ECCV 2026同期举办的第8届大规模视频目标分割（LSVOS）挑战赛中的移动统一多模态理解（MUMU）赛道。MUMU要求单一统一模型在0.5B参数和8 GB峰值推理内存的预算内，联合执行针对质量、场景和事件词表的多概念图像标注、开放词汇目标检测以及简洁图像描述。提交结果按加权任务分数乘以效率因子进行排名。我们描述了任务、规则与评估协议，报告最终结果，并回顾前三名团队的方法。三个领先方案均建立在紧凑的Florence-2-base模型之上，但以不同方式对其扩展：带跨任务推理细化的轻量标注头；在覆盖感知的多源数据上训练、并采用任务相关解码的共享低秩适配器；以及一个免训练流水线，将描述映射为标签并应用检测测试时增强。结果表明，当针对每个任务分别设计监督、解码和跨任务线索时，紧凑的基于提示的视觉-语言模型可以服务全部三类输出，而新类别上的开放词汇检测仍是主要瓶颈。

items.title_en: DecoEdit: Beyond Flat Control for 3D-Aware Unified Image Editing
items.abstract_en: While recent advances in multimodal image editing have achieved impressive results, current frameworks remain largely confined to ``flat" 2D controls (e.g., text prompts, bounding boxes, or masks). Precise 3D-aware geometric manipulation -- such as coordinating an object's location, physical scale, and 3D orientation while strictly preserving its fine-grained identity -- remains an elusive challenge, typically suffering from severe detail degradation or requiring expensive per-instance fine-tuning. In this paper, we present DecoEdit, an all-in-one image editing framework that goes beyond flat control by seamlessly integrating 1D textual, 2D spatial, and 3D volumetric inputs under a unified architecture. First, to power this unified model, we establish a data curation pipeline and curate a large-scale dataset, namely DecoDataset, containing 1.6 million samples, encompassing diverse multi-dimensional (1D/2D/3D) tasks and their complex compositions. Furthermore, we establish a comprehensive image editing benchmark named DecoBench to systematically evaluate multi-task editing performance. Finally, to address the fundamental trade-off between complex spatial transformations and identity preservation, we propose a novel decoupled pipeline: DecoEdit factorizes the editing process by utilizing structural guidance from SAM-3D to anchor the target geometry, scale, and spatial orientation, while concurrently leveraging a detail-preservation path to lock in high-fidelity textures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DecoEdit achieves state-of-the-art results. Notably, on the challenging 3D spatial pose and orientation control tasks, DecoEdit significantly outperforms leading closed-source models such as Seedream 5.0 in both geometric accuracy and identity consistency.

items.title_zh: DecoEdit：超越平面控制的 3D 感知统一图像编辑
items.abstract_zh: 尽管多模态图像编辑的最新进展取得了令人印象深刻的结果，但当前框架在很大程度上仍局限于“平面”2D 控制（例如文本提示、边界框或掩码）。精确的 3D 感知几何操作——例如协调对象的位置、物理尺度和 3D 朝向，同时严格保持其细粒度身份——仍然是一项难以实现的挑战，通常会出现严重的细节退化，或需要昂贵的逐实例微调。在本文中，我们提出 DecoEdit，一个一体化图像编辑框架，通过在统一架构下无缝集成 1D 文本、2D 空间和 3D 体积输入，超越了平面控制。首先，为支撑这一统一模型，我们建立了一个数据整理流程，并构建了一个大规模数据集 DecoDataset，包含 160 万个样本，涵盖多样化的多维（1D/2D/3D）任务及其复杂组合。此外，我们建立了一个全面的图像编辑基准 DecoBench，以系统评估多任务编辑性能。最后，为解决复杂空间变换与身份保持之间的基本权衡，我们提出了一种新颖的解耦流程：DecoEdit 通过利用 SAM-3D 的结构引导来锚定目标几何、尺度和空间朝向，同时利用细节保持路径锁定高保真纹理，从而对编辑过程进行因子化。大量实验表明，DecoEdit 取得了最先进的结果。值得注意的是，在具有挑战性的 3D 空间姿态和朝向控制任务上，DecoEdit 在几何准确性和身份一致性方面均显著优于 Seedream 5.0 等领先闭源模型。

items.title_en: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
items.abstract_en: We present a method that achieves state-of-the-art results for synthesizing novel views of complex scenes by optimizing an underlying continuous volumetric scene function using a sparse set of input views. Our algorithm represents a scene using a fully-connected (non-convolutional) deep network, whose input is a single continuous 5D coordinate (spatial location $(x,y,z)$ and viewing direction $(θ, φ)$) and whose output is the volume density and view-dependent emitted radiance at that spatial location. We synthesize views by querying 5D coordinates along camera rays and use classic volume rendering techniques to project the output colors and densities into an image. Because volume rendering is naturally differentiable, the only input required to optimize our representation is a set of images with known camera poses. We describe how to effectively optimize neural radiance fields to render photorealistic novel views of scenes with complicated geometry and appearance, and demonstrate results that outperform prior work on neural rendering and view synthesis. View synthesis results are best viewed as videos, so we urge readers to view our supplementary video for convincing comparisons.

items.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种方法，通过使用稀疏的输入视图集优化底层连续体积场景函数，在合成复杂场景的新视图方面取得了最先进的结果。我们的算法使用全连接（非卷积）深度网络表示场景，其输入是单个连续的5D坐标（空间位置 (x,y,z) 和观察方向 (θ, φ)），输出是该空间位置处的体积密度和与视角相关的发射辐射亮度。我们通过查询沿相机光线的5D坐标来合成视图，并使用经典体积渲染技术将输出的颜色和密度投影到图像中。由于体积渲染天然可微，优化我们的表示所需的唯一输入是一组相机位姿已知的图像。我们描述了如何有效优化神经辐射场，以渲染具有复杂几何形状和外观的场景的逼真新视图，并展示了优于先前神经渲染和视图合成工作的结果。视图合成结果最好以视频形式观看，因此我们敦促读者观看我们的补充视频以进行有说服力的比较。

items.title_en: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
items.abstract_en: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss.

items.title_zh: REAL 损失：为推测解码优化真实期望接受长度
items.abstract_zh: 推测解码通过让草稿模型提出多个 token，由目标模型在一次前向中验证，从而加速 LLM 推理。加速效果由期望接受长度（EAL）决定，但交叉熵、KL 散度和全变差等标准训练目标仅关注分布匹配或单步重叠。近期研究转而提出块级训练目标，旨在直接优化 EAL。然而，这些目标仍是代理目标，而非 EAL 的精确表述。例如，一些方法在目标分布延续上对后续接受度取平均，而不是在被接受 token 所选择的验证分支上取平均，从而引入协方差差距，可能逆转梯度方向。我们分析了这一差距，并推导出 REAL，一种真实 EAL 训练损失，它使用路径权重进行无偏估计，并使用 Rao-Blackwellization 降低方差。在与 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 目标和 Domino 草稿器进行的受控损失级比较中，REAL 在 9 个任务子集和 5 个评估种子上，在概率化服务接受长度上优于 WTV、VSD、DBLast 和静态 LK 基线。这些增益仅需改变训练损失，无需修改草稿器架构或推理流程，证明了真实 EAL 训练的实用性。REAL 损失的参考实现见 https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss。

items.title_en: Wireless Edge-Assisted Adaptive Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action Models in Physical AI
items.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable embodied artificial intelligence (AI) by translating visual observations and language instructions into robotic actions. Emerging use cases in physical AI are expected to drive the need for efficient inference and communication, as the computational demands of the VLA models pose challenges for real-time control with limited onboard resources. Test-time scaling through latent reasoning allows these models to refine hidden representations without generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens, but introduces a trade-off between task success, inference latency, and energy consumption. In this paper, we address the efficient collaborative inference under a realistic communication scenario. We propose a wireless edge-assisted framework for adaptive latent reasoning (WEALR) that augments onboard computation with edge computing. A decision-making agent jointly selects the execution location and latent-reasoning convergence threshold. We formulate this joint adaptation as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP). A Lagrangian-constrained deep reinforcement learning (CDRL) approach, namely trust region policy optimization Lagrangian (TRPO-Lag), learns to balance task performance and resource consumption under varying wireless conditions and task requirements. We evaluate the framework using LIBERO manipulation tasks, profiled VLA inference costs, and ray-traced wireless channels. Experimental results demonstrate that TRPO-Lag achieves up to 23% higher feasibility-weighted task success rate compared to benchmark CDRL methods.

items.title_zh: 面向物理AI中视觉-语言-动作模型的无线边缘辅助自适应潜在推理
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将视觉观察和语言指令转化为机器人动作，使具身人工智能（AI）成为可能。物理 AI 中新兴的用例预计将推动对高效推理和通信的需求，因为 VLA 模型的计算需求对有限车载资源下的实时控制构成挑战。通过潜在推理进行测试时扩展使这些模型能够细化隐藏表示而无需生成显式思维链（CoT）token，但引入了任务成功率、推理延迟和能耗之间的权衡。本文中，我们解决现实通信场景下的高效协同推理问题。我们提出一种无线边缘辅助的自适应潜在推理框架（WEALR），用边缘计算增强车载计算。决策智能体联合选择执行位置和潜在推理收敛阈值。我们将这种联合自适应建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）。一种拉格朗日约束深度强化学习（CDRL）方法，即信赖域策略优化拉格朗日（TRPO-Lag），学习在不同无线条件和任务需求下平衡任务性能与资源消耗。我们使用 LIBERO 操作任务、剖析的 VLA 推理成本和光线追踪无线信道评估该框架。实验结果表明，与基准 CDRL 方法相比，TRPO-Lag 实现了最高 23% 更高的可行性加权任务成功率。

items.title_en: Human or Synthetic? What a Fixed Budget Buys for Post-Training
items.title_zh: 人类还是合成？固定预算能为后训练买到什么
items.abstract_en: Post-training of large language models typically combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based fine-tuning such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). Human-annotated and synthetically generated preference data differ substantially in per-sample cost, but prior work typically holds sample count fixed when comparing the two. In this work, we explicitly study the interplay between cost and performance by comparing the effect of post-training with human and synthetic preference data under a fixed, dollar-matched annotation budget. We train and evaluate multiple base model families across helpfulness and summarization tasks. We find that synthetic data is far more cost-efficient at low-to-moderate budgets, achieving high win rates with as little as \$200--\$400. On helpfulness, human data closes the gap only at budgets roughly two orders of magnitude larger; on summarization, it does not close the gap at any tested budget. We also find that human-annotated data varies in reliability: one widely used human preference source substantially underperforms another, and the gap persists even after standard remedies such as domain restriction and deduplication.
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型的后训练通常将监督微调（SFT）与基于偏好的微调（如直接偏好优化，DPO）相结合。人工标注和合成生成的偏好数据在每样本成本上差异很大，但先前工作在比较两者时通常固定样本数量。在这项工作中，我们通过在固定的、按美元成本匹配的标注预算下比较使用人类和合成偏好数据进行后训练的效果，明确研究成本与性能之间的相互作用。我们在有用性和摘要任务中训练并评估多个基础模型系列。我们发现，在低到中等预算下，合成数据的成本效率要高得多，仅用 200–400 美元即可获得高胜率。在有用性方面，人类数据只有在预算大约高出两个数量级时才能缩小差距；在摘要方面，它在任何测试预算下都未能缩小差距。我们还发现，人工标注数据的可靠性存在差异：一个广泛使用的人类偏好来源显著劣于另一个，并且即使在领域限制和去重等标准补救措施之后，这一差距仍然存在。

items.title_en: Safety as a Budget: Calibrating the Control Channel of Constrained GRPO for Vision-Language Models
items.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning can teach vision-language models (VLMs) to decline harmful image-text requests, but how safe the result becomes is set indirectly, through reward weights found by trial runs. Stating safety as budgets on the rate of harmful assistance and the rate of over-refusal, enforced by Lagrange multipliers inside GRPO with an off-the-shelf scorer as the cost, is the natural fix, and it fails twice. The multiplier compares the scorer's mean with the budget, and scorers built for ranking get the mean wrong: a fixed-point analysis shows that the mean bias, not the budget, then decides whether the multiplier settles, saturates or switches off. And standard GRPO standardizes the penalized reward within each group, which cancels the multiplier before it reaches the gradient. Two-channel constrained GRPO repairs both: the base reward keeps the raw score for the within-group comparison, the penalty and the constraint estimate pass through a monotone map fitted on judge-labeled training responses, and the advantage keeps the multiplier. On a Qwen3-VL-2B policy with a training-free readout of an open 4B model as the scorer, held-out harm on 1,037 adversarial prompts falls from 8.9% under standard GRPO to 4.8%, lower in every seed, where the uncalibrated budget gives 7.6%; over-refusal stays at most 2% on 400 benign queries and MMBench is unchanged. The gain is largest where the intent sits in the image (10.1% -> 5.1%) and grows on the unseen HADES benchmark (28.9% -> 12.8%). Order-preserving distortions of the scores reproduce each predicted controller state in every seed, and the results hold under a map fitted on another judge's labels, an image-reading judge and a human audit.

items.title_zh: 安全作为预算：校准用于视觉-语言模型的约束 GRPO 的控制通道
items.abstract_zh: 强化学习可以教会视觉-语言模型（VLM）拒绝有害的图像-文本请求，但结果的安全程度是通过试验运行找到的奖励权重间接设定的。将安全性表述为对有害协助率和过度拒绝率的预算，并由 GRPO 内部的拉格朗日乘子强制执行、以现成评分器作为代价，是自然的修正方案，但会在两处失效。乘子将评分器的均值与预算进行比较，而为排序构建的评分器会把均值算错：定点分析表明，此时决定乘子是稳定、饱和还是关闭的是均值偏差，而不是预算。并且标准 GRPO 会在每个组内对受惩罚奖励进行标准化，这会在乘子到达梯度之前将其抵消。双通道约束 GRPO 修复了这两个问题：基础奖励在组内比较中保留原始分数，惩罚项和约束估计通过一个在评委标注的训练回复上拟合的单调映射，而优势函数保留乘子。在 Qwen3-VL-2B 策略上，以开放 4B 模型的免训练读出作为评分器，1,037 个对抗提示上的留出危害率从标准 GRPO 下的 8.9% 降至 4.8%，且在每一个随机种子中都更低，而未校准预算给出 7.6%；在 400 个良性查询上过度拒绝率至多为 2%，MMBench 保持不变。当意图位于图像中时增益最大（10.1% -> 5.1%），并在未见过的 HADES 基准上进一步增大（28.9% -> 12.8%）。对分数进行保序失真可在每个种子中复现每个预测的控制器状态，并且结果在由另一位评委的标签拟合的映射、一个读图评委以及人工审计下依然成立。

items.title_en: SearchChord: Prompt Preselection and Field Recomposition for One-Step Image Editing
items.abstract_en: Finding effective prompts and seeds for one-step image editors requires balancing edit fidelity, source preservation, and computational cost. To address this challenge, we explore a large collection of candidate edits, where each candidate is defined by a unique prompt-seed pair, and generate corresponding images on demand. We present SearchChord, a training-free framework that leverages a large pool of such candidates, combining text-based preselection, image verification, and latent-field recomposition. Our ablation studies across pool sizes up to 200 candidates show that a pool of 100 offers a cost-effective operating point. Compared with feeding all 100 candidates into recomposition, TextSim preselects a subset of 10 candidates. Rather than uniform averaging, we incorporate image-verifier scores to weight each candidate during recomposition. Experiments on PIE-Bench and the proposed CropWeed-EditBench reveal a trade-off: candidate selection improves target-text alignment, while recomposition better preserves unmodified source content. The oracle verifier achieves the best performance in both preservation and target-text alignment. Practical verification partially recovers semantic alignment, but recomposition still compromises edit fidelity, including in agricultural image edits. These results motivate text-first preselection and stronger verification to balance preservation, fidelity, and cost. Code and data will be made publicly available.

items.title_zh: SearchChord：面向单步图像编辑的提示预选与场重组
items.abstract_zh: 为单步图像编辑器寻找有效提示和种子需要在编辑保真度、源内容保留和计算成本之间取得平衡。为应对这一挑战，我们探索大量候选编辑，其中每个候选由唯一的提示-种子对定义，并按需生成对应图像。我们提出 SearchChord，这是一个无需训练的框架，利用大量此类候选，结合基于文本的预选、图像验证和潜在场重组。我们在最多 200 个候选的池规模上进行的消融研究表明，100 个候选的池提供了一个成本有效的操作点。与将所有 100 个候选输入重组相比，TextSim 预选 10 个候选的子集。我们不是进行均匀平均，而是在重组期间纳入图像验证器分数来为每个候选加权。在 PIE-Bench 和提出的 CropWeed-EditBench 上的实验揭示了一种权衡：候选选择改善了目标文本对齐，而重组更好地保留了未修改的源内容。oracle 验证器在保留和目标文本对齐两方面均取得最佳性能。实际验证部分恢复了语义对齐，但重组仍会损害编辑保真度，包括在农业图像编辑中。这些结果促使采用文本优先的预选和更强的验证，以平衡保留、保真度和成本。代码和数据将公开提供。

items.title_en: Box-conditional Hypothesis Testing for Out-of-Distribution Object Detection
items.abstract_en: Detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) objects is essential for ensuring the reliability and safety of object detectors in real-world deployment. We treat the decision on a detected box as a hypothesis test with the null hypothesis that the box covers an object of an in-distribution (ID) class. The null distribution changes with the size of the box and its contact with the image border, and the detector observes both. The test can therefore rank a box only against ID boxes of the same size and border contact, which gives a distribution-free bound on the false-alarm rate for each of them and uncovers the separation that one null distribution hides. The power of the test also rests on the layer it reads. Layers built only for the ID classes have no reason to keep what sets an unknown object apart, so the test reads the features before them. We propose \textbf{PLUM}, a training-free score that pools the last backbone stage inside the box and ranks its distance to the ID classes among ID boxes of the same size and border contact. On the standard benchmark, PLUM reaches the highest AUROC among the compared methods without external models, with 91.5 and 94.5 on PASCAL-VOC and 95.1 and 97.5 on BDD100K. Code: https://github.com/DDOZMI/PLUM

items.title_zh: 用于分布外目标检测的框条件假设检验
items.abstract_zh: 检测分布外（OOD）目标对于确保目标检测器在现实部署中的可靠性和安全性至关重要。我们将对检测框的决策视为假设检验，零假设是该框覆盖一个分布内（ID）类别的目标。零分布随框的大小及其与图像边界的接触而变化，而检测器观察到这两者。因此，该检验只能将框与具有相同大小和边界接触的 ID 框进行排序比较，这为每个框给出了无分布假设的误报率界，并揭示了单一零分布所掩盖的分离。检验的功效还取决于它所读取的层。仅为 ID 类别构建的层没有理由保留使未知目标与众不同的内容，因此该检验读取它们之前的特征。我们提出 PLUM，一种无需训练的分数，它池化框内最后一个骨干阶段，并在具有相同大小和边界接触的 ID 框中对某框到 ID 类别的距离进行排序。在标准基准上，PLUM 在无外部模型的比较方法中达到最高 AUROC，在 PASCAL-VOC 上为 91.5 和 94.5，在 BDD100K 上为 95.1 和 97.5。代码：https://github.com/DDOZMI/PLUM

items.title_en: NVFP4-MLA: Unified FP4 KV-Cache Storage and Attention Computation for Multi-Head Latent Attention
items.abstract_en: Long-context reasoning and agentic workloads make key-value (KV) cache capacity and attention computation the dominant costs of serving frontier large language models. We present NVFP4-MLA, the first design to push both KV-cache storage and attention computation of multi-head latent attention (MLA) to FP4. NVFP4-MLA co-designs the quantization algorithm with the attention kernel and the cache system. Selective residual compensation preserves model accuracy by adding NVFP4 residuals only to the quantization-sensitive channels. Two-dimensional quantization blocks make the shared latent cache compatible with the different reduction directions of the two attention batched matrix multiplications (BMMs), removing requantization between them. On DeepSeek-R1 and Kimi-K3, NVFP4-MLA matches BF16 MLA average accuracy across nine benchmarks while compressing the MLA KV cache by 3.20x and 3.05x relative to BF16 MLA. On NVIDIA Rubin GPUs, NVFP4-MLA speeds up the attention kernel over FP8 MLA by up to 2.82x on DeepSeek-R1 and 2.71x on Kimi-K3, and lowers p90 time to first token in agentic multi-turn serving by up to 3.5x and 2.1x, respectively. In disaggregated DeepSeek-R1 serving, it also raises per-GPU throughput by up to 2.30x.

items.title_zh: NVFP4-MLA：面向多头潜在注意力的统一FP4 KV缓存存储与注意力计算
items.abstract_zh: 长上下文推理和智能体工作负载使键值（KV）缓存容量和注意力计算成为服务前沿大语言模型的主要成本。我们提出 NVFP4-MLA，这是首个将多头潜在注意力（MLA）的 KV 缓存存储和注意力计算都推进到 FP4 的设计。NVFP4-MLA 将量化算法与注意力内核和缓存系统协同设计。选择性残差补偿仅对量化敏感通道添加 NVFP4 残差，从而保持模型准确率。二维量化块使共享潜在缓存兼容两个注意力批量矩阵乘法（BMM）的不同归约方向，消除了它们之间的重新量化。在 DeepSeek-R1 和 Kimi-K3 上，NVFP4-MLA 在九个基准上匹配 BF16 MLA 的平均准确率，同时相对于 BF16 MLA 将 MLA KV 缓存压缩 3.20 倍和 3.05 倍。在 NVIDIA Rubin GPU 上，NVFP4-MLA 在 DeepSeek-R1 和 Kimi-K3 上的注意力内核相比 FP8 MLA 分别最高加速 2.82 倍和 2.71 倍，并将智能体多轮服务中的 p90 首 token 时间分别最高降低 3.5 倍和 2.1 倍。在分离式 DeepSeek-R1 服务中，它还将每 GPU 吞吐量最高提升 2.30 倍。

items.title_en: Refinement vs. Replanning: Inference Compute Allocation in Robot Policies
items.abstract_en: A frozen chunked robot policy can spend deployment-time inference compute in two coupled ways: more work within each policy call to refine a predicted action chunk, or more frequent policy calls to replan from fresh observations. We study this allocation without updating model weights. Our evaluation procedure reports success with both nominal compute rate and complete attempt cost, selects comparisons on discovery tasks, and tests prespecified comparisons on held-out tasks. Comparisons added after inspecting the held-out results only summarize observed patterns. We demonstrate the procedure with one frozen SmolVLA checkpoint in synchronous LIBERO simulation, using denoising count as the refinement control and fixing chunk length at K=50. Arithmetic and latency characterize cost differently: at d=10, 82.1% of counted arithmetic is independent of denoising, whereas a descriptive affine fit to fixed-input host time assigns 17.7% to its intercept. At h=2, d=2 succeeds on 139/160 attempts versus 122/160 for d=5 (+10.6 percentage points; task-conditional 95% interval: +4.4 to +16.9), while using 5.9% less arithmetic per control step. Executing h=5 rather than h=2 at d=2 yields 138/160 versus 139/160 successes and 60.7% lower arithmetic per attempt; equivalence is not established. The case study shows why deployment adaptation must evaluate generation effort and feedback frequency jointly; it does not define a universal setting.

items.title_zh: 细化与重规划：机器人策略中的推理计算分配
items.abstract_zh: 一个冻结的分块机器人策略可以通过两种相互耦合的方式花费部署时的推理计算：在每次策略调用内做更多工作以细化预测的动作块，或以更高频率调用策略以根据新观测重新规划。我们在不更新模型权重的情况下研究这一分配。我们的评估流程同时报告标称计算速率和完整尝试成本下的成功率，在发现任务上选择比较，并在留出任务上测试预先指定的比较。在检查留出结果后添加的比较仅总结观察到的模式。我们用一个冻结的 SmolVLA 检查点在同步 LIBERO 仿真中演示该流程，使用去噪步数作为细化控制，并将块长度固定为 K=50。算术运算量和时延对成本的刻画不同：在 d=10 时，所计算术运算量的 82.1% 与去噪无关，而对固定输入主机时间做描述性仿射拟合时，其截距占 17.7%。在 h=2 时，d=2 在 160 次尝试中成功 139 次，而 d=5 为 122/160（+10.6 个百分点；任务条件 95% 区间：+4.4 至 +16.9），同时每个控制步使用的算术运算量少 5.9%。在 d=2 时执行 h=5 而非 h=2，得到 138/160 对 139/160 的成功次数，且每次尝试的算术运算量低 60.7%；未确立等价性。该案例研究说明了为何部署适配必须联合评估生成投入与反馈频率；它并未定义通用设置。

items.title_en: VEPO: Mitigating Multilingual Hallucinations in LVLMs via Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization
items.title_zh: VEPO：通过视觉证据引导的偏好优化缓解LVLM中的多语言幻觉
items.abstract_en: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) achieve strong multimodal performance, yet they remain prone to object hallucination---generating answers that are linguistically fluent but visually ungrounded. This issue is especially severe in low-resource languages, where weaker cross-modal alignment causes models to rely more on language priors than on image evidence. Existing remedies either require costly multilingual annotations or external translation/reward models, or intervene at inference time in ways that can distort the output language. We propose VEPO(Visual Evidence-guided Preference Optimization), a training-time method that transfers reliable visual grounding from English to other languages without external models. VEPO first localizes key visual evidence using English queries via mid-layer cross-modal attention, then constructs preference pairs that share the same correct answer but differ in evidence sufficiency (full image vs.\ key-region masked image). Direct preference optimization on these pairs encourages low-resource inputs to prefer answers supported by complete visual evidence. Experiments on multilingual POPE and MME with Chinese, French, and Hindi show consistent hallucination reduction and perception gains, with the largest improvements on the lowest-resource language. Analyses further confirm that VEPO sharpens question-relevant attention and that evidence-guided masking outperforms random masking.
items.abstract_zh: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）实现了强大的多模态性能，但仍易出现物体幻觉——生成语言流畅但视觉上缺乏依据的答案。该问题在低资源语言中尤为严重，因为较弱的跨模态对齐使模型更依赖语言先验而非图像证据。现有补救措施要么需要昂贵的多语言标注或外部翻译/奖励模型，要么在推理时进行干预，而这种方式可能扭曲输出语言。我们提出VEPO（视觉证据引导的偏好优化），一种训练时方法，可在不使用外部模型的情况下将可靠的视觉依据从英语迁移到其他语言。VEPO首先通过中间层跨模态注意力使用英语查询定位关键视觉证据，然后构建偏好对，这些偏好对共享相同的正确答案，但在证据充分性上不同（完整图像 vs. 关键区域被掩蔽的图像）。对这些偏好对进行直接偏好优化，鼓励低资源输入偏好由完整视觉证据支持的答案。在中文、法语和印地语的多语言POPE和MME上的实验显示，幻觉持续减少且感知性能提升，其中最低资源语言的改进最大。分析进一步证实，VEPO使与问题相关的注意力更锐化，并且证据引导的掩蔽优于随机掩蔽。

items.title_en: Can a Vision-Language Model Tune Clustering In Context?
items.abstract_en: Clustering is a widely used unsupervised learning method, but selecting an appropriate algorithm and set of hyperparameters for a specific dataset can require many possible configurations and evaluations. In this work, we investigate whether a Vision-Language Model can instead visually evaluate clustering results and use those decisions to then tune an explicit clustering algorithm. We study this through three progressive experiments using Qwen3.5-27B and five controlled synthetic clustering scenarios. First, we test whether the VLM can distinguish the best clustering result from a pair of plots. Second, we test whether it can assign numerical scores to those plots where a higher score represents a better result. Finally, we use these judgments within an agentic loop in which the VLM scores a k-means clustering and proposes updated hyperparameters that may result in better clustering. Our exploratory results show that the VLM performs well when clear cluster structure is present, while struggling on more ambiguous and noisy settings. In the full agentic experiment, the VLM produces clustering configurations with silhouette scores relatively close to those of grid search and Bayesian optimization, while terminating in much fewer iterations. Overall, these results provide an initial proof of concept that VLM-based visual feedback can be used to autonomously tune an explicit clustering algorithm.

items.title_zh: 视觉-语言模型能否在上下文中调优聚类？
items.abstract_zh: 聚类是一种广泛使用的无监督学习方法，但为特定数据集选择合适的算法和超参数集合可能需要评估大量可能配置。在本工作中，我们研究视觉-语言模型（VLM）能否转而以视觉方式评估聚类结果，并利用这些判断来调优一个显式聚类算法。我们使用 Qwen3.5-27B 和五个受控的合成聚类场景，通过三个递进实验来研究这一点。首先，我们测试 VLM 能否从一对图中区分出最佳聚类结果。其次，我们测试它能否为这些图赋予数值分数，其中更高分数表示更好结果。最后，我们将这些判断用于一个智能体循环中，VLM 在该循环中对 k-means 聚类进行评分，并提出可能带来更好聚类的更新超参数。我们的探索性结果表明，当存在清晰聚类结构时 VLM 表现良好，而在更模糊和噪声更大的设置中则表现吃力。在完整的智能体实验中，VLM 产生的聚类配置的轮廓系数与网格搜索和贝叶斯优化相对接近，同时终止所需的迭代次数少得多。总体而言，这些结果提供了初步的概念验证：基于 VLM 的视觉反馈可用于自主调优一个显式聚类算法。

items.title_en: KnowVis: Dual-View Evaluation and Diagnosis of World-Knowledge Grounding in Text-to-Image Models
items.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models have made substantial progress in visual realism, aesthetic quality, and instruction following. However, real-world prompts often go beyond explicit visual descriptions and require implicit facts, structured knowledge, and domain-specific commonsense. Existing evaluations mainly focus on explicit prompt-to-image semantic alignment or specific knowledge subdomains, lacking unified evaluation and diagnosis of world-knowledge grounding in T2I models. We introduce KnowVis for dual-view evaluation and diagnosis of world-knowledge grounding in T2I generation. Built on a hierarchical knowledge taxonomy with case-level annotations, KnowVis combines two complementary benchmark views with a structured MLLM-based VQA judge protocol. The Skill-Tree Benchmark supports fine-grained atomic knowledge evaluation, while the Generalized Benchmark examines open-ended knowledge composition and expression. The protocol uses Required VQAs to assess atomic knowledge correctness in the Skill-Tree Benchmark, and combines Required, Optional, and dynamically discovered knowledge expressions with human-judge collaborative evaluation in the Generalized Benchmark. We validate the protocol's reliability on the Skill-Tree validation split, enabling scalable evaluation and diagnostic error attribution. Experiments show that KnowVis reveals notable gaps in world-knowledge grounding across existing T2I models and provides structured diagnostic signals for knowledge-intensive image generation.

items.title_zh: KnowVis：文本到图像模型中世界知识 grounding 的双视角评估与诊断
items.abstract_zh: 文本到图像（T2I）模型在视觉真实感、美学质量和指令遵循方面取得了实质性进展。然而，真实世界提示往往超出显式视觉描述，需要隐含事实、结构化知识和领域特定常识。现有评估主要关注显式提示到图像的语义对齐或特定知识子领域，缺乏对 T2I 模型中世界知识 grounding 的统一评估与诊断。我们提出 KnowVis，用于对 T2I 生成中的世界知识 grounding 进行双视角评估与诊断。KnowVis 建立在具有案例级标注的分层知识分类体系之上，将两个互补的基准视图与基于 MLLM 的结构化 VQA 评判协议相结合。Skill-Tree Benchmark 支持细粒度原子知识评估，而 Generalized Benchmark 考察开放式知识组合与表达。该协议在 Skill-Tree Benchmark 中使用 Required VQA 评估原子知识正确性，并在 Generalized Benchmark 中将 Required、Optional 和动态发现的知识表达与人类评判协作评估相结合。我们在 Skill-Tree 验证划分上验证了该协议的可靠性，从而实现可扩展评估和诊断性错误归因。实验表明，KnowVis 揭示了现有 T2I 模型在世界知识 grounding 上的显著差距，并为知识密集型图像生成提供结构化诊断信号。

items.title_en: Unlocking Cross-Attention in Label-Scarce Regimes: A Weakly Supervised Approach for Video Semantic Segmentation
items.title_zh: 在标签稀缺场景中释放交叉注意力：一种用于视频语义分割的弱监督方法
items.abstract_en: Weakly Supervised Video Semantic Segmentation (WS-VSS) aims to learn temporally consistent semantic object masks in videos using only video-level labels. While fully supervised models successfully learn temporal relationships by means of cross-attention, training these temporal weights under weak supervision is unstable and even pushes the model below its single-frame baseline. Therefore, existing WS-VSS methods exploit temporal consistency by relying on external priors, such as optical flow. Unfortunately these cues are non-semantic, computationally expensive and noisy, degrading the supervisory signal. Instead of supervising attention weights directly or using external priors, we propose MemCAM, a WS-VSS transformer framework that learns temporal cross-attention directly through feature-space self-supervision. MemCAM introduces a CAM Propagation Algorithm that synthesizes a supervisory signal by propagating past CAMs according to patch-level feature similarities in the latent space. Specifically, we constrain their induced CAMs through a consistency objective between predicted and propagated maps, stabilizing temporal attention learning. Experiments on the YouTube-Objects v2.2 and WS$^2$ datasets demonstrate that MemCAM consistently outperforms the temporal localization and segmentation performance of WS-VSS alternatives, showing that cross-attention can be effectively trained in label-scarce video settings through internal self-supervision.
items.abstract_zh: 弱监督视频语义分割（WS-VSS）旨在仅使用视频级标签学习视频中时间一致的语义对象掩码。完全监督模型通过交叉注意力成功学习时间关系，而在弱监督下训练这些时间权重不稳定，甚至会使模型低于其单帧基线。因此，现有WS-VSS方法依赖外部先验（如光流）来利用时间一致性。不幸的是，这些线索是非语义的、计算昂贵且含噪，会降低监督信号。我们提出MemCAM，一种WS-VSS Transformer框架，不直接监督注意力权重或使用外部先验，而是通过特征空间自监督直接学习时间交叉注意力。MemCAM引入CAM传播算法，该算法根据潜在空间中块级特征相似性传播过去的CAM来合成监督信号。具体而言，我们通过预测图与传播图之间的一致性目标约束其诱导的CAM，从而稳定时间注意力学习。在YouTube-Objects v2.2和WS$^2$数据集上的实验表明，MemCAM在时间定位和分割性能上持续优于WS-VSS替代方法，表明可以通过内部自监督在标签稀缺的视频设置中有效训练交叉注意力。

items.title_en: SpecRelay: Amortize or Avoid the Round Trip in Edge-Cloud Speculative Decoding
items.abstract_en: Edge-cloud speculative decoding moves autoregressive drafting to an edge device while a larger cloud model verifies draft tokens in parallel, so that edge drafting and cloud verification overlap under a synchronous draft-verify schedule. Beyond low-latency local networks, however, the next verification request of that schedule can be sent only after the previous reply arrives, so every round still waits out a full round trip, and throughput falls as the network RTT grows. To recover this loss, we present SpecRelay, an edge-cloud LLM inference system that addresses this cost at two levels: it amortizes round trips when cloud verification is necessary and avoids them when local reasoning suffices. For cloud-bound queries, an asynchronous verification pipeline keeps fixed-budget draft trees in flight while earlier replies are still outstanding, and the cloud rejects stale requests before the target-model forward pass (the asynchronous schedule). At the query level, an RTT-conditioned router (the Latency-Aware Router) estimates quality and completion latency for three on-device modes (direct generation, Chain-of-Draft, and full reasoning) and cloud speculative decoding, selecting among them under a configurable accuracy-latency objective without adding latency during inference, since the router runs concurrently with the draft-model prefill. The asynchronous schedule alone improves decoding throughput by up to 50% over a reproduced synchronous baseline across multiple benchmarks. At matched target-model accuracy and 250 ms of added round-trip latency, the full system with the router delivers 1.95x and 1.55x the throughput of the same baseline on SPROUT and OlympiadBench, respectively, while sending only 47% and 39% of the queries to the cloud.

items.title_zh: SpecRelay：在边云推测解码中分摊或避免往返
items.abstract_zh: 边云推测解码将自回归起草移至边缘设备，而更大的云端模型并行验证草稿 token，使得在同步的起草-验证调度下，边缘起草与云端验证重叠。然而，在低时延本地网络之外，该调度中的下一个验证请求只能在上一个回复到达后发送，因此每一轮仍需等待完整的往返时延，且吞吐量随网络 RTT 增大而下降。为挽回这一损失，我们提出 SpecRelay，一种边云 LLM 推理系统，在两个层面应对该开销：当云端验证必要时分摊往返成本，而当本地推理足够时避免往返。对于发往云端的查询，异步验证流水线在先前回复仍未返回时保持固定预算的草稿树在途，云端在目标模型前向传播之前拒绝过期请求（即异步调度）。在查询层面，一个以 RTT 为条件的路由器（Latency-Aware Router）估计三种设备端模式（直接生成、Chain-of-Draft 和完整推理）与云端推测解码的质量和完成时延，并在可配置的精度-时延目标下从中选择，且不会在推理期间增加时延，因为该路由器与草稿模型预填充并发运行。仅异步调度在多个基准上就将解码吞吐量较复现的同步基线提升至多 50%。在目标模型精度匹配且额外往返时延为 250 ms 时，带路由器的完整系统在 SPROUT 和 OlympiadBench 上分别达到同一基线吞吐量的 1.95 倍和 1.55 倍，同时仅将 47% 和 39% 的查询发送至云端。

items.title_en: Bring Back Language to Actions: Restoring VLM capabilities in VLA Models via Parameter Merging
items.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

items.title_zh: 让语言回归动作：通过参数合并恢复 VLA 模型中的 VLM 能力
items.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）通过在机器人示范数据上微调预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）获得，从而能够根据视觉观测和语言指令预测动作。然而，这种微调会引发灾难性遗忘，显著降低原始 VLM 的语义和视觉 grounding 能力。我们通过合并 VLM 及其 VLA 衍生模型的参数来解决这一问题，而无需重新训练任一模型。具体而言，我们提取任务向量（VLA 与 VLM 权重之差），并通过奇异值分解对其进行分解。对于每个分量，我们学习一个标量混合系数，控制保留多少 VLA 适配，并以联合保持动作预测和视觉-语言能力为目标进行优化。实验表明，我们的合并模型同时在两个轴上表现良好，持续优于已有的合并基线。
